question: How does WRN gene effect vary with continuous MSI score in colorectal cell models?

wrnSummary.inference: Descriptive association in this model cohort; no categorical classification or causal estimate.

sources.name: DepMap 24Q4 Public v1
sources.attribution: DepMap, Broad (2024). DepMap 24Q4 Public. Figshare+. Dataset. https://doi.org/10.25452/figshare.plus.27993248.v1

limits: Continuous MSI scores are not converted into MSI/MSS categories.
Missing scores remain missing, not zero.
This is a related analysis of the same cell models, not independent replication.
Association does not establish clinical efficacy or treatment selection.
Historical manuscript annotations and group contrasts are absent from this dataset.

donorSensitivity.method: Select complete MSI/gene-effect pairs, then take each measurement median within source donor.
limits: Aggregation reduces repeated representation of known source donors; it does not control other confounders.
Medians summarize distinct models; the median pair is not necessarily an observed single model.
Donor identity comes from the pinned DepMap release. This is a sensitivity analysis, not independent validation.
